reason: Hypothesis A is more specific and testable: it clearly identifies interface-mediated dislocation dynamics (nucleation and pileup) as the governing mechanism, proposes a concrete intervention (post-deposition annealing to alter short-range order), and defines a measurable predicted outcome (lower creep rate) against a well-defined baseline, with a decisive falsification experiment.
